question: What practices are traditionally recognized together as this purification discipline?
premises: Purification of the individual soul is named.
Purification of the mind is named.
Breath control is named as part of the same teaching.
inference: This discipline is remembered as purification of soul, purification of mind, and breath control.
plain_english: This is remembered as purification of the individual soul, purification of the mind, and breath control.
